title: Cheap material/see through. Would NOT recommend.
text: Cheap material/see through. Would NOT recommend.. This is super cheap (crappy) material. I recently bought a cervical bamboo pillow and needed an affordable pillow case. This got decent reviews so I bought it. It’s see through and was frayed. I had to burn the threads. See my pic for reference. It’s practically threadbare. If I didn’t need it in a pinch, I’d return it. I will definitely be looking for a better quality pillow case. Until then, it’s better than nothing. My pillow looks NOTHING like the other reviews material.
